messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: runtime queue tail latency and 5xx spike in us-west-2. Oncall: @Alex R. Link to alert dashboard https://internal.monitoring/r/3509876543
Alex R: oncall here, joining the bridge now, pulling logs
Alex R: quick check - model-srv-3 queue depth at 98% for the last 3m, tail lat 420-480ms, request timeouts rising. KV cache hit steady.
Maya L: available to help with traffic shaping, what routes are hot?
Alex R: primarily embeddings endpoint and large-batch generate calls: /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Top key is prod-acme-1 and prod-beta-2.
Sam T: propose immediate per-key rate cap on prod-acme-1 and lowering max_in_flight on the model-srv pool to shed backlog. Also disable experimental streaming on edge nodes.
Alex R: applying mitigations now. Steps:
```bash
redwoodctl rate-limit update prod-acme-1 --rps 8
redwoodctl rate-limit update prod-beta-2 --rps 5
redwoodctl runtime config set --pool model-srv --max-in-flight 40 --shedding-threshold 75 --request-timeout 10s
```
Jamie P: thanks. I will also flip off streaming-early-exit on edge cluster 2 and pause batch-prewarm for large sequences.
Jamie P: disabled streaming-early-exit on edge-2, paused batch-prewarm jobs. Confirming config push succeeded.
Alex R: great, monitoring. IncidentBot: customer impact summary - active P1 reports from AcmeCorp and BetaApps, seeing 502 and timeout spikes. Escalate if not improved in 15m.
Maya L: metrics update after 2m: model-srv-3 queue depth trending to 55%, error rate down to 1.3% from 4.1%, tail latency dropped to ~180ms.
Sam T: looks like rate caps + shedding are taking effect. Recommend keeping rate caps for 20m then gradually relax.
Alex R: agree. I'll keep max_in_flight smaller for now to reduce head-of-line blocking; capacity team on standby to add 2 nodes if spike persists.
Jamie P: note - lowering max_in_flight may increase client-side timeouts if clients retry aggressively. We reduced request timeout to 10s to fail fast and avoid queue pileup.
Alex R: oncall handover planned in 30m, Maya will take shift if stable. I'll document command history and add runbook notes to the incident doc: https://redwood/incidents/3509876543
Maya L: taking over once Alex hands off. Ping me if any regressions.
Alex R: thanks team. Leaving monitoring alerts for 15m quiet window and will update if anything else changes. :thumbsup:
Sam T: :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Mitigations applied by Alex R and Jamie P. Next check in 10m.
